title: Premium Months Covered from a Term Life Insurance Terminal Illness Advance
content:
**Term Life Insurance.** The premium months to cover from a terminal illness advance are set as follows:

1. While an approved waiver of premium claim is on file for the policy: **none**.
2. Otherwise, when the physician-certified life expectancy on the approved accelerated benefit claim is 6 months or less: **6 months**.
3. Otherwise: **the life expectancy in months**.

| Hypothetical case | Premium months to cover |
|---|---|
| Approved waiver of premium claim on file; life expectancy 5 months | none |
| No approved waiver claim; life expectancy 4 months | 6 |
| No approved waiver claim; life expectancy 6 months | 6 |
| No approved waiver claim; life expectancy 11 months | 11 |
